Steam Guide: Avorion Admin Commands [and Cheats]
Avorion Admin Commands - Citadel Servers Wiki

notes: RCON is Source-flavour and is switched on simply by setting a password: AvorionServer takes --rcon-ip / --rcon-port / --rcon-password on the command line and rconIp / rconPort / rconPassword in server.ini, so there is no separate enable setting. The official wiki gives 27015 as the default RCON port and CubeCoders' AMP template drives Avorion with AdminMethod=SourceRCON on 27015/TCP; that template also sends /stop as its shutdown string, which is the evidence that commands keep their leading slash over RCON rather than dropping it. The command set is the same one an in-game admin types. NO BROADCAST: no say/chat/broadcast command appears in any copy of the in-game /help. Legion Hosting publishes /say and /players for Avorion; nothing else corroborates either and its /admin form also contradicts the documented /admin -a / -r, so both were rejected rather than recorded. NO ROSTER: listPlayers is deliberately absent. The nearest command is /player, which LogicServers and Citadel (quoting the in-game help) describe as 'prints the number of players' while BisectHosting paraphrases it as 'shows the players on the server'; a count cannot be parsed into rows, so guessing a playerParse here would have shipped an empty roster. Avorion moderates by player NAME, not Steam ID - /kick, /ban and /unban all take the name per the in-game help. Reported disagreement: Legion Hosting says /unban takes a Steam ID (the ban itself is said to store the player's Steam ID in the server blacklist); the help text says player name. Names containing spaces are risky because the parser is token-based (compare /w <name> <message>) and no source documents a quoting form. Related commands not modelled: /banip <ip>, /unbanip <ip>, /blacklist, /whitelist, /admin -a <name>, /admin -r <name>, /save, /stop, /seed, /version. A writable stdin console exists on the server process as well (AMP sets HasWriteableConsole), taking the same slash-prefixed commands; RCON is preferred.
